account:
So far I have found no clear evidence of unusual town business. Several townsfolk repeated that the baker was carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery, and I later saw the baker carrying a sack of bread near the market. That seems consistent with ordinary baking and selling, though the repeated reports caught my attention. My neighbour says they chatted with the baker, who said there was no special occasion today. I do not know of any gathering or hidden purpose behind the bread.

I tried to ask freight about trade, but they crossed eastward and apparently did not hear my question. My shout became part of the news townsfolk repeated, and the neighbour asked what my announcement was. I explained that it was only a question about trade, not an announcement.

The secretary has the appointment book and reported no correspondence. They were investigating the unspecified host and location of my three-o'clock tea. I have now confirmed directly with the neighbour that tea is at their cottage at (16, -60, 105), nearest the east landing. The secretary spoke while I was heading home, but I could not make out the words, so I do not know whether they found anything else. I am now home for lunch, with town accounts at the office due at one. My feeling that something may be happening without me remains only a suspicion, not a conclusion supported by what I have learned.
